    tsdst.modeling.prettyConfMat¶

    tsdst.modeling.prettyConfMat(Ytrue, Ypred, print_=True, margins=True, labels=None)[source]¶

    Return and optionally print a labeled confusion matrix with margins.

    Parameters:
    Ytruearray-like

    Actual class labels.

    Ypredarray-like

    Predicted class labels, in the same observation order as Ytrue.

    print_bool, optional

    Print the result table. The default is True.

    marginsbool, optional

    Include row totals, column totals, and a grand total. The default is True.

    labelsdict, optional

    Map displayed names to observed class values. Dictionary insertion order controls both axes. If None, sorted observed class values are used.

    Returns:
    confmatpandas.DataFrame

    Actual classes are rows and predicted classes are columns. Each axis has a corresponding Actual or Predicted group label. Optional margins use the label Total.

    Notes

    For binary class values ordered [0, 1], the cells are [[TN, FP], [FN, TP]]. Custom display names and a different requested class order change the labels and ordering together; they do not transpose the matrix.
